purpose: Cut bounded subtractive features directly into observed existing rigid static UC GLB rectangular-prism meshes, including rotated stock, hash-linked notch chains, and cumulative round-hole chains whose v0.6 sweep supports arbitrary non-overlapping same-axis hole layouts without the earlier projection-separability requirement.

properties.source_path: existing ordinary .glb creation outside protected live machine body
properties.path: distinct target .glb path outside protected live machine body
properties.specification: closed v0.2 axis-aligned cut recipe, v0.3 oriented cut recipe, v0.4 cumulative box-notch recipe, v0.5 projection-separable hole-chain recipe, or axm.mesh-hole-fabrication-chain/v0.6 general same-axis round-hole sweep recipe
properties.expected_source_sha256: optional exact lowercase SHA-256 binding, with optional sha256: prefix
properties.lineage_path: v0.4-v0.6 optional prior lineage JSON receipt when appending to a previous chain output; v0.6 accepts a verified v0.5 hole lineage as an upgrade parent
properties.receipt_path: v0.4-v0.6 optional distinct output JSON receipt path; defaults beside the output GLB
properties.expected_lineage_sha256: v0.4-v0.6 optional exact prior lineage SHA-256 binding

contains: exact source and output GLB SHA-256 bindings
source topology and proven rectangular-prism frame evidence
hash-linked cumulative operation lineage and final receipt digest
deterministic prior-output reconstruction before resume append
v0.6 vertical sweep events at resolved hole polygon x-coordinates
v0.6 synchronized free-region seams and split hole walls so no hidden internal walls are introduced
exact polygonized removed-area and closed-mesh volume agreement
v0.5-to-v0.6 lineage upgrade evidence when used
output closed oriented edge-manifold candidate evidence

relationships: reuses the existing static GLB geometry decoder, seam-weld topology inspector, proven oriented stock frame, deterministic GLB publisher and validator
v0.4 remains the bounded cumulative box-notch path
v0.5 remains available for its previously verified projection-separable multi-hole outputs and receipts
v0.6 removes only the same-axis projection-separability restriction by vertically decomposing the rectangular cross-section at every resolved polygon x event
v0.6 splits top/bottom free regions and matching hole side walls at shared sweep events so all material boundaries weld without internal fabrication walls
v0.6 can consume a v0.5 lineage only after the v0.5 compiler exactly rebuilds and matches the supplied parent GLB
source artifacts remain read-only and publication remains separate/rollback-capable
limitations: v0.6 cumulative sweep remains bounded to at most 32 non-overlapping/non-touching polygonized round through-holes on one proven fabrication axis of one rigid rectangular-prism root stock.
The same-axis projection-separability requirement is removed, but notch-and-hole mixing and cross-axis cumulative chains remain unavailable rather than approximated.
The v0.6 sweep is a bounded rectangular-stock polygon-hole decomposition, not a claim of general arbitrary polygon triangulation or arbitrary 3D boolean CSG.
As new cumulative holes add sweep x events, collinear tessellation points on older hole walls may be refined; the resolved physical hole polygon, polygonized area and per-hole digest stay unchanged.
Multiple source primitives/components, skins, animation, morphs, UVs, textures, tangents, vertex colours, joints and unsupported material state remain rejected.
Lineage receipts are content-hashed and exact-output-bound, but are not cryptographic authorship signatures or external trust anchors.
Edge-manifold topology and explicit non-overlap are checked; visual quality, structural strength, real manufacturing behavior and host-engine import remain unproven.

truth.basis: Exact source/frame state, per-hole physical polygon receipts, sweep decomposition, lineage hashes, deterministic prior reconstruction, volume agreement, topology, output digest and limitations are explicit.

agency.basis: The caller chooses source, axis, hole locations/radii/resolution/kerf and continuation receipt; overlap, cross-axis, mixed-operation and freeform requests still fail closed.

continuity.basis: v0.6 preserves append-only lineage, verifies exact previous bytes before continuation, supports verified v0.5 lineage upgrade, keeps source artifacts read-only and retains rollback-capable output/receipt publication.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: The sweep adds only the smallest geometry generalization it can prove: arbitrary non-overlapping same-axis round-hole layouts on rectangular stock, with manifold and volume gates before publication.
